lines.t: Da Ming goes to school on foot every day.
I like playing the Erhu in my free time.
Tom began to learn Chinese last year.
What a nice kitchen you have.
In our country, it's polite to shake hands when we meet.
Betty, the hat is so lovely. Is it yours or Timmy's?
Neither, it is Kate's.
How often do you make a study tour, Grace?
We make a study tour every spring and every autumn.
Shall we go to watch a movie this Saturday afternoon?
Alright.
There is one at 2 o'clock and one at 5 o'clock.
Let's make it 2 o'clock. I have to get home before 6 o'clock.
Ma Li, what did you do last weekend?
I stayed at home reading. I felt relaxed and comfortable. What about you, Wang Qing?
I went to Yan'an. It was meaningful. I listened to the stories of the Red Army.
Can I help you, madam?
Yes, I'd like to buy a gift for my daughter.
The new year is coming. The clothes are on sale. The trousers are 45 yuan, and the skirt is 65 yuan.
How about the shoes?
Sorry, they are not on sale. They are still 55 yuan.
I see. I'll take the skirt.
I'm home, Mom. Look at these vegetables.
Wow! They look nice. Are they from the market or the farm?
Well, they are from the vegetable garden in our school.
Do you plant them by yourself?
Right, I plant potatoes. Helen plants tomatoes, and Nancy plants carrots. We share our vegetables with each other.
Great, Bill. We can make tomato and egg soup tonight.
Ermm. I don't like it. Why not make some carrot juice?
Good idea.
Hi, Wu Dong.
Hey, Lucy.
I heard you went to a summer camp. Can you tell me something about it?
There were different kinds of lessons in the summer camp, such as kite making, paper cutting and 3D printing.
What lesson did you take?
3D printing and paper cutting.
Cool! Did you make anything special with 3D printing?
Yes, I made a model bridge for my mother as a birthday gift.
Good for you.

Are you a storybook lover? Have you thought about designing a new cover for your favorite storybook? We are going to have a book cover design competition. The works should be handed in before next Monday. The winners will get a set of popular storybooks signed by the writers as prizes. Here are some rules you should follow. Firstly, you can use colored pencils only. Then choose no more than four colors, and pick one of them to be the main color on the cover. Lastly, make sure you draw the cover all by yourself. If you want to join in, please visit our website for more information.

notes: 来源页面文字中问号全部丢失（显示为空格），已按句意补回“?”。
第4段对话：原文 “What about you ,Wang Ting” 与题干 “Wang Qing” 不一致，按题干改为 Wang Qing；“I felt relax” 改为 “I felt relaxed”；“It’s was meaningful” 改为 “It was meaningful”；“red army” 改为 “Red Army”。
第7段对话：“such as kite making. Paper cutting and 3D printing” 改为 “such as kite making, paper cutting and 3D printing”。
第三节短文：“a set of popular storybook” 改为 “a set of popular storybooks”。
